title: Nematode revived after 46,000 years in Siberian permafrost

plain: In 2023 it was reported that a nematode, a tiny worm, had been brought back to life after 46,000 years frozen in the permafrost of Siberia, the ground in the far north of Russia that stays frozen all year. A guest called Dr. Gilbert mentions the report without saying where it appeared. He brings it up to show how long life can survive in a frozen state.
